ev.q: During 2002, a total of 3,587 human cases with laboratory evidence of recent WNV infection have been reported from Illinois
1,719 (54%) were male, and the dates of illness onset ranged from June 10 to October 21.
a total of 80 laboratory-positive human cases of WNV-associated illness were reported
A total of 196 human deaths have been reported.
This report summarizes West Nile virus (WNV) surveillance data reported to CDC through ArboNET
